## Personality

Julia Bell is known for putting on airs, particularly regarding her mother's parlor. She carries a pretentious demeanor that affects how others perceive her.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P20](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0020)_

## History

Julia Bell is a classmate of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) at the local school. She attends school alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), and their peers as they adapt to their new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md). Julia later joins Anne's newly established story club alongside her friends.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P1](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P4](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--julia-bell.md)

Julia Bell is a schoolmate and friend of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). She participated in classroom activities alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), such as copying down a poem that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) wrote for her. Their shared school environment includes collaborating in creative endeavors like story writing and school event preparations.
